description.zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。

实例的更多信息，请参见[实例概述](~~356505~~)。
description.en:
The ID of the instance. You can view the **ID** of the instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

>*   If your instance has an ID, you must specify the ID for this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.****
>*   If no **Overview** page or **ID** is generated for your instance, you do not need to configure this parameter.

For more information, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

description.zh: 设备所属云网关产品的**ProductKey**。
description.en: The **ProductKey** of the gateway product to which the device belongs.

descriptions.zh:
## 使用说明
本接口适用于查询JT/T 808协议、GB/T 32960协议和SL 651协议云网关设备的信息。

使用云网关协议接入设备的具体流程和通信说明，请参见[JT/T 808协议云网关概述](~~474256~~)、[GB/T 32960协议云网关概述](~~2248990~~)和[SL 651协议云网关概述](~~2636038~~)。

## QPS限制

单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为50。

> 单个阿里云账号下的所有RAM用户共享该阿里云账号的配额。
descriptions.en:
## How-To  
This API is used to query information about cloud gateway devices that use the JT/T 808 protocol, GB/T 32960 protocol, or SL 651 protocol.  

For details about the process and communication specifications for connecting devices using cloud gateway protocols, see [Overview of JT/T 808 Protocol Cloud Gateway](~~474256~~), [Overview of GB/T 32960 Protocol Cloud Gateway](~~2248990~~), and [Overview of SL 651 Protocol Cloud Gateway](~~2636038~~).  

## Queries per second (QPS) limit  

The maximum queries per second (QPS) for a single Alibaba Cloud account when calling this API is 50.  

> All Resource Access Management (RAM) users under an Alibaba Cloud account share the quota of that Alibaba Cloud account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot query-vehicle-device --iot-instance-id iot-2w0000 --product-key a1Bw0000 --device-name light --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun iot QueryVehicleDevice --region cn-hangzhou --IotInstanceId 'iot-2w0000' --ProductKey a1Bw0000 --DeviceName light
